summary.text: Ron Estes is the Republican incumbent representing Kansas's 4th District since 2017, elected in a special election to succeed Mike Pompeo. A civil engineer by training who worked in consulting and management, he previously served as Sedgwick County Treasurer and Kansas State Treasurer. He chairs the Social Security subcommittee of the House Ways and Means Committee.

paragraphs.text: Estes was born in Topeka, Kansas, in 1956. According to his official biography, he is a fifth-generation Kansan who grew up on his family farm.
He earned a bachelor's degree in civil engineering in 1973 and a master's degree in business administration in 1983, both from Tennessee Technological University, according to Ballotpedia.
Estes began his career in consulting and management roles in the aerospace, energy and manufacturing industries, according to his official biography, and also worked as a businessman and farmer.
He served as Sedgwick County Treasurer from 2004 to 2010 and as Kansas State Treasurer from 2011 to 2017.
Estes won the April 11, 2017 special election to replace Mike Pompeo, who left Congress to become CIA director, defeating Democrat James Thompson and Libertarian Chris Rockhold.
In the 2025-2026 Congress he serves on the Ways and Means Committee, where he chairs the Social Security subcommittee, as well as the Budget Committee and the Joint Economic Committee.

His official biography says he has worked on tax reform, the farm bill, Wichita's aviation industry and Title X family planning guidelines, and that he supports military families and veterans. It says he lives in Wichita.
